language_focus_examples: Past tenses and used to / would
Future forms (will, going to, present continuous, future perfect)
Modals and modal perfects (deduction, obligation, regret)
Conditionals (zero, first, second, third) and mixed conditionals
The passive voice (all tenses) and causative have
Connectors, linkers and discourse markers for extended texts
_note_structure: Keys 'bidang' (=Skill), 'standard_kandungan' (=Content Standard) and 'standard_pembelajaran' (=Learning Standard) reuse the engine's keys. Wording targets the official DSKP Form 5 (CEFR B1 High). See 'source' for per-section verification status.

standard_kandungan.nama: Understand meaning in a variety of familiar and unfamiliar contexts

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Understand independently the main ideas in extended texts on a wide range of familiar topics and some unfamiliar topics.
Understand independently specific information and details in extended texts on a wide range of familiar topics and some unfamiliar topics.
Recognise independently attitudes or opinions in extended texts on a wide range of familiar topics and some unfamiliar topics.
Understand independently longer sequences of supported classroom instructions.
Understand independently a wide range of more complex questions.
Understand independently longer, more complex narratives on a wide range of familiar topics.

standard_kandungan.nama: Use appropriate listening strategies in a variety of contexts

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Guess the meaning of unfamiliar words from clues provided by other words and by context on a wide range of familiar topics and some unfamiliar topics.

standard_kandungan.nama: Recognise features of spoken genres on familiar and some unfamiliar topics

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Recognise with little or no support typical features at word, sentence and text levels of a range of spoken genres.

standard_kandungan.nama: Communicate information, ideas, opinions and feelings intelligibly on familiar topics

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Explain information on familiar topics from diagrams, charts, tables, graphs or other visuals.
Ask about and explain advantages and disadvantages of ideas, plans and arrangements.
Explain and justify plans and ambitions.
Explain and justify the point of view of classmates or others.
Explain and justify own feelings or those of others.
Use formal and informal registers appropriately in most familiar and some unfamiliar contexts.
Keep interaction going in discourse-level exchanges by asking for and giving clarification, and by paraphrasing and rephrasing.

standard_kandungan.nama: Communicate appropriately to a small or large group on familiar topics

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Explain the main points of an idea or argument to a small or large group.

standard_kandungan.nama: Understand a variety of texts by using a range of appropriate reading strategies to construct meaning

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Understand the main points in extended texts on a wide range of familiar topics and some unfamiliar topics.
Understand specific details and information in extended texts on a wide range of familiar topics and some unfamiliar topics.
Guess the meaning of unfamiliar words from clues provided by other words and by context on a wide range of familiar topics and some unfamiliar topics.
Use independently a range of familiar and some unfamiliar print and digital resources to check meaning and extend understanding.
Recognise independently the attitude or opinion of the writer in extended texts on a wide range of familiar topics and some unfamiliar topics.
Recognise with little or no support typical features at word, sentence and text levels of a wide range of genres.

standard_kandungan.nama: Explore and expand ideas for personal development by reading independently and widely

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Read a variety of suitable print and digital texts to investigate and analyse global issues, and give a personal response.

standard_kandungan.nama: Communicate intelligibly through print and digital media on familiar topics

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Explain and evaluate information that is (i) seen (ii) read (iii) heard.
Explain advantages and disadvantages of (i) ideas (ii) plans or (iii) arrangements.
Explain the main points for and against an idea or argument.
Express and respond to real or imagined opinions and feelings.
Organise, sequence and develop ideas within a text of several paragraphs on familiar and some unfamiliar topics.

standard_kandungan.nama: Communicate with appropriate language, form and style

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Punctuate written work on a range of text types with reasonable accuracy.
Spell written work on a range of text types with reasonable accuracy.
Produce a plan or draft of three paragraphs or more and modify this appropriately, either independently or in response to feedback.
Use formal and informal registers appropriate to the target audience in most familiar and some unfamiliar situations.

standard_kandungan.nama: Engage with, respond to and interpret a variety of literary text types

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Respond to and explain in some detail how a text is relevant to one's own or others' lives.
Explain in some detail the development of plot, characters, themes and setting in a text.

standard_kandungan.nama: Analyse and evaluate a variety of literary text types

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Identify and explain in some detail the key stylistic features of a text and evaluate the effect they create.

standard_kandungan.nama: Express an imaginative response to literary texts

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Respond imaginatively and intelligibly by creating a range of print and digital products such as presentations, visuals, posters, blogs and webpages.

_note_rpt: Rancangan Pengajaran Tahunan (yearly scheme of work) RECONSTRUCTED from the 12 English Download [B1+] units mapped across a standard ~40-week Malaysian academic year. No single official ministry RPT PDF was captured, so this is an editable template: each unit gets ~3 teaching weeks rotating the five skills, with orientation, mid/end-of-year assessment and revision weeks inserted. Teachers should adjust dates and week counts to their school calendar. 'standard_kandungan' lists the Content Standard codes emphasised that week.
